$comment: Canonical Brasfield & Gorrie brand tokens. 2026 Brand Update. Single source of truth — read this rather than hardcoding values. Verified against the official '2026 Brand Update FINAL' guide (44 pp), the Q1 2026 one-pager, and the supplied logo/font assets.
updated: 2026 Brand Update (Q1 2026). Change vs. prior system: GREEN 1 removed from the PRIMARY palette (green survives in the secondary palette for site logistics / pursuit materials).

blue_1.name: Blue 1
blue_1.role: Pale highlight / tint accent. Use sparingly.

blue_2.name: Blue 2
blue_2.role: Bright accent blue; links, highlights, accents on dark.

blue_3.name: Blue 3
blue_3.role: Vivid mid blue; secondary accent, data viz.

blue_4.name: Blue 4
blue_4.role: PRIMARY brand navy. Default logo color, headings, primary surfaces. This is THE brand color.

blue_5.name: Blue 5
blue_5.role: Darkest navy; deep backgrounds, footers, near-black surfaces.
blue_5.$note: The 2026 Brand Update PDFs misprint the Blue 5 hex as #00003C. Brand team confirmed (July 2026): correct value is RGB 0/20/60 = #00143C — also what the one-pager's vector art uses. Do not 'fix' this to match the printed label.

gray_1.name: Gray 1
gray_1.role: Light neutral; subtle backgrounds, panels, dividers, table stripes.

black.name: Black
black.role: Single-color print, body text where navy is too light, hard contrast.

color_strategy.print: Toned down and simple: avoid layering many colors, rely on high contrast. (2026 guide p.16)
color_strategy.digital: Vivid and bold: the full palette used generously, colors layered for rich layouts. (2026 guide p.16)

secondary_colors.$comment: Expanded SECONDARY palette (2026 guide p.17) for charts/graphs and utility graphics — internal documents, UI, presentations, proposals. Use monochromatically (e.g. five greens differentiating pie slices), not as brand surfaces or accents. Green was removed from the PRIMARY palette only — these greens remain sanctioned for site logistics and pursuit materials. Values transcribed from the official palette page (image-only in the PDF).

magnus.$comment: Magnus platform sub-brand (2026 guide section 4.4). The wordmark is lowercase 'magnus' when it appears with the 'm' icon; the icon may stand alone where context exists. Never affix a version designation ('2.0') outside a launch phase, and NEVER affix 'AI' to the wordmark.

magnus_blue.name: Magnus Blue
magnus_blue.role: Digital-only vibrant variant of Blue 1. Will NOT reproduce accurately in traditional CMYK print — use Blue 1 #B0FFFF for print.

logo.$comment: The 'm' symbol IS supplied (product artwork, vector-exact). The 'magnus' WORDMARK and the full icon+wordmark lockup are NOT — ask for that artwork rather than typesetting the wordmark yourself.

types.symbol: The Magnus 'm' icon alone. Supplied. Use where Magnus context already exists, or as an app icon/avatar/favicon.
types.wordmark: Lowercase 'magnus' wordmark. NOT supplied — ask for the artwork; never typeset it in Sharp Grotesk or any other face.
types.lockup: 'm' icon + lowercase 'magnus' wordmark — the full Magnus logo. NOT supplied — ask for the artwork.

colors.magnusblue: #1DFFFF — Magnus Blue. The signature digital treatment, on dark/navy surfaces only. Not for CMYK print.
colors.blue5: #00143C — Blue 5. Deep alternative on light surfaces; quieter than Blue 3.
colors.black: #000000 — single-color/mono print, including CMYK where Magnus Blue can't reproduce.

logo.artwork_note: SVGs are cropped tight to the mark with no built-in padding — add clear space yourself.
logo.clear_space: Clear space on all sides = the height of the 'm' symbol's left stem. Scales with the mark.

fonts.$comment: Sharp Grotesk PE. Each weight+width is its own named family (the trailing number is the WIDTH axis baked into the family name; subfamily is always 'Regular', so reference by full family name, not by CSS font-weight). Family names below are the exact internal names — use verbatim in CSS font-family, python-pptx font.name, and docx-js font.

primary.role: PRIMARY typeface. Titles, headlines, large high-level text.

headline_impact.role: Bold high-impact titles, 1-3 words ALL CAPS (up to 6 words, all caps or title case; never sentence case). Ads, covers, banners. Tracking 10-25 when all caps.

subhead_book.role: High-impact subheaders, org-chart hierarchy, numeric infographics. All caps (tracking 10-25) for short headers, or title case as subheader.

display_thin.role: Large light display only; never body.

font_fallback_stack: 'Sharp Grotesk PE Book 20', 'Sharp Grotesk PE SmBold 15', Verdana, Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

logo.exclusion_zone: Clear space on all sides = the height of the capital 'B' in 'Brasfield'. Scales proportionally with the mark.
logo.$min_size_note: Official minimums per the 2026 guide p.8: stacked 0.75 in / 100 px; horizontal 1.25 in / 200 px; stacked-with-'General Contractors' 1.5 in / 200 px. The symbol's minimum isn't specified in the guide — 24 px is this skill's practical floor.

types.stacked: Two-line wordmark. For square/portrait space or when horizontal space is limited.
types.horizontal: Single-line wordmark. PREFERRED when space permits. Wide formats: nav bars, headers, signage, email headers. Never carries 'General Contractors'.
types.stacked_gc: Stacked wordmark WITH the 'General Contractors' descriptor. Official variant, but use ONLY when further context is demanded. Asset not supplied in this skill — ask for the artwork rather than typesetting the descriptor.
types.symbol: The ampersand mark alone. Use where space is tight or brand context is already established (favicons, avatars, app icons, watermark crops).

colors.white: #FFFFFF — for dark/navy backgrounds and busy photography
colors.black: #000000 — single-color/mono print or where navy lacks contrast
colors.brightblue: blue_2 #3888FF — accent treatment on very dark navy only; never the default
